column1: # E1: edit anywhere. Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column3: Edit anywhere: nvim at the pointer, then paste
column9: A small floating nvim (INSERT mode) next to the pointer for text fields without vim. Starts with the selected text (primary selection) when there is any. Ctrl+S, ZZ or :wq: copy the text, refocus the window you came from and paste it (Ctrl+V, Ctrl+Shift+V for terminals), replacing the selection; :q! or closing the window: nothing is pasted. The clipboard you had is put back after a few seconds.
